Many people think we need better models, but the real bottleneck in AI is human imagination. In this clip from the OpenClaw fireside chat, Peter Steinberger explains why we already have the technology to change the world. By cleverly applying existing intelligence, open source maintainers are constantly fixing and inventing new things. Watch the full conversation on the GitHub channel to learn more.
